description: Main source file for a Flutter-based Notes application, defining UI components, state management, data models, and app structure.

classes.name: AppColors
classes.description: Defines the color palette used throughout the app.

classes.name: Note
classes.description: Data model representing a note, including id, title, content, tags, createdAt, and updatedAt.

classes.name: NotesProvider
classes.description: State management class handling note collection, filtering, addition, update, and deletion.

classes.name: NotesApp
classes.description: Root widget that initializes the app with theme and provider.

classes.name: NotesHomePage
classes.description: Main screen displaying list or grid of notes, with tag filtering and navigation to note detail/edit screens.

classes.name: _TagFilterDropdown
classes.description: Dropdown widget for selecting note tags to filter notes.

classes.name: _NotesListView
classes.description: List view of notes optimized for narrow screens.

classes.name: _NotesGridView
classes.description: Grid view of notes optimized for wide screens.

classes.name: _NoteTile
classes.description: Reusable card widget displaying individual note preview with tap and menu options.

classes.name: _NoteTilePopupMenu
classes.description: Popup menu for editing or deleting a note.

classes.name: NoteDetailScreen
classes.description: Screen for creating a new note or editing an existing one, with fields for title, content, tags, and save/cancel controls.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point initializing the Flutter app with NotesApp as the root widget.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Overridden build methods in various widgets to render UI components.

methods.name: _handleSave
methods.description: Handles saving note data from the note creation/edit screen.

methods.name: _handleAddTag
methods.description: Adds a new tag to the list in the note detail screen.

methods.name: _handleRemoveTag
methods.description: Removes a specified tag from the list in the note detail screen.
